topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I haven’t slept right since those flowers bloomed on your doorstep. The soil was still cold when I plucked them, thinking they’d bring a smile in these lean days. I should’ve known better than to send them without a word. Now, every time I see you in the village, you look elsewhere, and I can’t meet your gaze. The saints know I’ve never been one for fine words, but maybe I should’ve found some. Maybe I should’ve just brought them to you, face to face, and taken whatever came of it. Now, the silence weighs heavier than any debt I owe.
